text:
jin: FYI opening a small docs PR to align the troubleshooting section for rate-limits, timeouts, and context handling with the SDK changes. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/498

emma: Nice — what's the main user-impact?

jin: Two things: 1) SDK now retries 429s by default with backoff+jitter, so we should stop showing manual retry loops in examples; 2) runtime now returns CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE (400) for hosted by default, while dedicated can be configured to truncate. Need clear migration guidance.

rajar: Agree. Also we had a bunch of internal examples that used fetch() + setTimeout for retries. We should replace those with SDK snippets and an "advanced" section for raw HTTP clients.

linda: On the advanced note, can we include a tiny JS fetch example that reads Retry-After and bails to an internal queue? Some enterprise customers explicitly want to honor Retry-After headers.
jin: Added an "Advanced: raw HTTP" mini-snippet showing reading Retry-After and enqueuing. Kept it short.

emma: Can we have both short JS and Python SDK snippets showing how to disable retries if folks want manual control? e.g., client = Redwood({retries:0})

jin: Yep. JS SDK snippet:
```js
import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference'
const c = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY }) // retries enabled
await c.generate({ model: 'redwood-3b', input: 'hi' })
```
And disable example:
```js
const c = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, retries: 0 })
```
Python examples included similarly.

rajar: We should also clarify error shapes. Hosted: 400 + code: CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE. 429s include standard Retry-After when present. Dedicated: admin-configurable truncation means some deployments will not surface 400s. Add a short table?

jin: I put a one-paragraph summary and a small bullet list 1 words max7. Also added a migration checklist: test critical flows, set up monitoring for unexpected 400s, and consider toggling SDK retries during rollout.

linda: Linkfixes: update any internal cross-links pointing to /guides/ratelimits -> /troubleshooting/rate-limits. Also fix examples path to examples/troubleshooting/rate-limits so relative links work.

ci-bot: Running docs CI for PR #498: linkcheck + lint

lint-bot: Minor lint: code-block language set to js for one block.

ci-bot: linkcheck passed.

jin: Addressed lint, updated a couple of wordings to avoid implying users must implement backoff. Replaced the old diagram (retry loop) with a single-line flow graphic: Client -> SDK -> Redwood -> Model.

emma: Can you add a release-notes blurb? Ill paste into the migration guide copy.
jin: Done (short blurb under "Platform changes").

rajar: Quick review done; wording nit on "silent truncation" changed to "implicit truncation". LGTM otherwise.

jin: Thanks. Planning to merge after CI. Will monitor customer migrations and update if we see regressions. :rocket:
